**Finding: missing (insurance covenant absent) — redline validated and submitted.**

- **Investigation:** The section outline contains no insurance article. A full-text search for "insurance" returned only p0051, which pushes insurance *costs* onto Licensee ("Licensee shall pay all taxes, customs, duties, insurance, shipping...") — the opposite of a coverage covenant. No precedent language was available in memory.
- **Direction check:** Licensor supplies and hosts the Licensed Technology through which our consolidated market data and Spot FX orders are transmitted (p0021, p0031, p0033), so it is a services/hosting vendor touching our data. An insurance covenant binds Licensor and benefits us, so it is properly flagged.
- **Redline:** Added a single new General Provisions subsection **(l) INSURANCE** after p0159 (the last operative subsection, before the execution paragraph) at preferred limits: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request, running through the term plus one year.
- **Negotiation posture:** The comment offers the playbook fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) in case the preferred limits exceed Licensor's existing program.
